scope: Finite Bayesian diagnostic fixture; no material simulator or real laboratory integration
comparator_selection: lowest mean realized loss on development worlds; lexicographic policy-name tie break
rng: SHA256-derived independent world, observation-source, and policy streams; common source tape only within identical stationary measurement model
latent_model: Three fair independent claim bits and one shared XOR sensor-fault bit per group; exact joint posterior over 16 hypotheses; independent groups
candidate_design: Per group: 3 biased sensors cost 1, 3 independent replications cost 2 or 4, shared calibration audit cost 2, known alias of sensor 0 cost 1, uninformative probe cost 1
task_design: Three individual claim bits, AND(0,1), OR(1,2), AND(0,2); unique task IDs
verification: strict candidate/source/scope binding; duplicate source deduplication; conflicting same-source receipts quarantine source; non-numeric outcomes yield no posterior update; stale sources removed by recomputing posterior
priority: exact expected reduction in Bayes decision risk / positive reserved cost; recompute after each receipt; deterministic candidate-ID ties
stopping: budget/step limit, no feasible candidates, or non-positive score for value/IG/importance; unknown receipt consumes full reserved cost, source is not retried
acceptance: pilot gain only if paired 95% interval above zero versus development-locked comparator, zero observed budget/known-invalid leakage, and no higher observed false-definitive count; otherwise mixed/null
deferred_from_full_protocol: bounded two-step policy at benchmark scale
full proof dependency DAG with alternate support paths
required_unit_controls: policy has no latent truth input
